stories.title: Canada’s forestry sector to receive record level funding
stories.summary: Minister of Energy and Natural Resources Tim Hodgson was in Powell River on Friday, unveiling the government's first-ever Forest Sector Strategy.

stories.title: The engineering feat at the heart of Canada’s next big Arctic build
stories.summary: The road – about 10 metres wide for traffic in both directions – will traverse low-lying tundra and a maze of lakes, ponds and streams, requiring about 230 bridges and culverts.

stories.title: Board of Metro Vancouver elects new chair as government pledges to downsize
stories.summary: The Regional District has been under fire since the massive cost overruns of the North Shore Wastewater Treatment Plant and concerns raised by several mayors and councillors.

stories.title: Child killer’s temporary release cancelled following Victoria police safety notice
stories.summary: Convicted child killer Shane Ertmoed will be getting out of a Vancouver Island prison for a temporary 60-day unsupervised furlough.

stories.title: Project to increase Trans Mountain pipeline flows starts up ahead of schedule
stories.summary: A further expansion of 210,000 barrels per day is expected to come into service by the end of 2028, bringing the system's total capacity to 1.19 billion barrels a day.

stories.title: Religious hospitals can refuse patient health care, B.C. Supreme Court rules
stories.summary: The court heard the case, which focused on 34-year-old Sam O’Neill, who had stage four cervical cancer and had chosen MAID to end her life.

stories.title: District of Squamish asks residents to limit indoor water use after wet B.C. weather
stories.summary: The rain and wind warnings have been dropped across British Columbia's coast, but flooding is still a risk as other communities manage the aftermath.

stories.title: Trina Hunt’s family alleges husband killed her, seeks return of assets in B.C. lawsuit
stories.summary: A new civil claim alleges Iain Hunt killed his wife and should be barred from benefiting financially from her death. The allegations have not been proven in court.

stories.title: Woman posts video saying she was harassed by youths on Vancouver bus
stories.summary: She says in her video that the group called her names, made rude gestures and one of them blew vape smoke in her face, all unprovoked.

stories.title: Summerland woman’s stolen family coin collection rebuilt by content creator
stories.summary: When Marcia Kozak evacuated Summerland during the Bald range wildfire, she took some of the most important things she could with her, her cat and her late mother’s coin collection.
